items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you know who Denise McClugagge is?

ctx.x: A little background to that: Pierre Salinger, whether you know it or not, could have had a career as a classical pianist. He used to come into the Geary Cellar in San Francisco when he was a writer for the [San Francisco] Chronicle. Didn’t he go with one of the girls downstairs?
Do you know who Denise McClugagge is?
